display_long_description:
#  Arrow Jam Tap Away Puzzle — Every arrow wants out — but only a clear path lets it escape.

**Arrow Jam** is a satisfying tap away puzzle where every move matters. Study the board, tap arrows in the right order, and clear each jam before three wrong moves cost all your lives.

[media]

# DISCOVER PICTURE-SHAPED PUZZLES
Not every board is a plain square. Untangle hearts, stars, trophies, symbols, and other recognizable shapes, mixed with classic geometric arrow mazes.

[media]

# KEEP PLAYING AFTER LEVEL 1,000
Complete the main campaign and continue with Extra Levels for an endless arrow puzzle challenge.

# WHY YOU’LL ENJOY ARROW JAM
- 1,000 unique campaign levels plus endless extra levels.
- Picture shapes and classic geometric layouts.
- Five difficulty tiers: Easy, Normal, Hard, Super Hard, and Nightmare with a smooth, carefully balanced difficulty curve.
- Four colorful visual themes.
- Replay unlocked levels and resume unfinished boards (progress auto saved).
- Helpful hints (3 per level) when you are stuck.
- Offline play with no time limits.
- Smooth controls (hands or controller), sounds, and haptic feedback.
- Single-player. No ads. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases.

# BUILT FOR PURE LOGIC & FUN
Whether you want a relaxing brain break or a huge logic challenge, Arrow Jam grows from quick tap away puzzles into massive Nightmare mazes with hundreds of interlocked arrows.
